The story

A room that fills up on word of mouth alone.

Mom's Tacos has never had a website. Everything anybody knows about this place, they heard from somebody who ate here first.

The room says the rest of it. Exposed brick, iron chandeliers, a painted mural on the back wall and long wooden tables built for a family that shows up all at once. There is room for everybody, which is why nobody seems to be in a rush to leave.

There is no reservation to make and no booking screen to work through — Mom's has never needed either one. You come in, you order at the counter, and the kitchen goes to work.

On Main Street

Getting here

Downtown Buckley, right on Main.

  1. Call ahead if you're in a hurry

    Takeout orders go in over the phone and are ready at the counter.

  2. Park on Main or in the lot

    Street parking out front, plus a lot — the door is the one with the street number lettered on the glass.

  3. Eat in the brick room

    Long shared tables, chandeliers and room for the whole family. Or take it home.
